evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/A/p formats long/int/double quantities, emits abbreviated K/M/B/T stack strings, parses abbreviated quantity strings back to long values, and formats plain comma-delimited numbers with English locale NumberFormat.
The class owns the exact regex ^-?[0-9,.]+([a-zA-Z]?)$ and the surviving ParseException messages '<value> does not resemble a properly formatted stack.' and 'Invalid Suffix: <suffix>'.

RuneLite net.runelite.client.util.QuantityFormatter contains the same quantityToStackSize, quantityToRSDecimalStack, parseQuantity, formatNumber and suffix-validation surface with the same validation literals and decimal formats; SpawnPK extends the suffix array with T.
Exact v308 rs/s/t/d and rs/s/t/m call this utility to render trading/price/received quantities, per-item values and multiplied stack totals, confirming the quantity-formatting role in live UI.

candidates.note: Historical RuneLite source identity plus exact-v308 bytecode fixes QuantityFormatter. SpawnPK's copy adds a T suffix but retains the same utility contract.
